description: Source code for the IAudioTrack interface implementation in Android, including BpAudioTrack class and onTransact method handling IPC calls.

classes.name: BpAudioTrack
classes.description: Proxy class for IAudioTrack interface, enabling IPC communication with the media service.

methods.name: getCblk
methods.description: Retrieves the control block memory associated with the audio track.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts playback of the audio track.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback of the audio track.

methods.name: mute
methods.description: Mutes or unmutes the audio track.

methods.name: attachAuxEffect
methods.description: Attaches an auxiliary effect to the audio track.

methods.name: allocateTimedBuffer
methods.description: Allocates a timed buffer for audio data.

methods.name: queueTimedBuffer
methods.description: Queues a timed buffer for playback.

methods.name: setMediaTimeTransform
methods.description: Sets a media time transformation for synchronization.
